home.tagline: Spot the letters. Race for words. Outscore your friends before time runs out.
home.viewHowToPlay: How to play — full rules & scoring

howToPlay.title: How to play
howToPlay.intro: Inspired by the classic road-trip game: four licence-plate letters appear, and everyone races to find the best word that uses them. More matching letters and a faster submit mean a higher score.

items.1: Enter a nickname and tap Create Game to host, or Join Game with a friend's 6-character passcode.
items.2: Share the passcode or invite link from the lobby so others can join — no accounts needed.
items.3: Disconnected? Rejoin with the same passcode and nickname to pick up where you left off.

items.1: The host sets the number of rounds, round duration, and dictionary language before starting.
items.2: When ready, the host taps Start Game. You can play solo or with any number of friends.

items.1: Before each round, the host chooses 4 letters — drawn at random or typed manually.
items.2: After a short countdown, every player sees the same letters at the same time.

items.1: Type a valid word containing at least one plate letter and tap Submit. You can submit as many words as you like.
items.2: Only you see whether your word was accepted and how many points it scored. Other players' words stay hidden until the round ends.
items.3: Tap I'm done when you can't find a better word. You won't be able to submit again this round.
items.4: The round ends when the timer runs out, or when every player has tapped I'm done.

items.1: Everyone's best word and score for the round are revealed.
items.2: You see the round leaderboard and the running total across all rounds.
items.3: The host taps Next Round to continue, or End Game on the final round.

items.1: The player with the highest total score wins. Tied players share the win.
items.2: Expand the round breakdown to see every word and score.
items.3: The host can tap Play Again to reset scores and start a new match with the same group.

wordRules.title: Word rules
wordRules.1: Must be in the dictionary, in base form (no plurals or conjugations).
wordRules.3: Must contain at least one of the 4 plate letters.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.note: You need at least <1>2 matching letters</1> to earn points. One matching letter is valid, but scores <2>0</2>.
scoring.footer: Only your best word per round counts. Points drop as the timer runs down.

lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.revealPossibleSolution: Reveal a possible solution at round end if nobody finds all 4 letters in order

summary.noOrderedSolution: No dictionary word has all 4 letters in order.
